主要内容: On February 12, 2016, Insperity, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2015. The press release was included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The filing was submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and included details about the company's financial performance. The press release was also incorporated by reference into the filing. The report was signed by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President of Legal, General Counsel, and Secretary of Insperity, Inc., on February 12, 2016. The filing was part of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
